title: RateLimitExceededFeedbackSignal
description: FeedbackSignal kind emitted when an agent attempts to emit an in-scope EconomicEvent that would exceed the rate_per_hour bound of its delegates-compute Commitment. Source of truth: Holochain DHT (elohim zome's existing FeedbackSignal entry type — extending via signal_kind vocabulary per project_signal_kind_extensible_protocol_class; no new DHT entry type). Canon: genesis/docs/architecture/rea-compute-commitment-primitive.md §3 reciprocity.

target.description: CID or agent identifier of the agent whose rate was exceeded. For Z.D this is the deploy-svc-agent.

declarer.description: CID or agent identifier of the agent (typically storage validator or operator's elohim-counsel) that declared the breach.

bounded_by.description: CID of the delegates-compute Commitment whose rate bound was exceeded.

recent_count.description: Actual count of in-scope events in the trailing hour window at the time of breach.
